plan.contextChunk: This figure illustrates the StyleGAN architecture, organized into three labeled vertical columns: the main generative pipeline (center), the noise injection branch (left of center), and the style branch (right). In the style branch, a latent variable z (1×1×512) is passed through a fully connected network to produce an intermediate variable w (1×1×512), which then feeds three separate linear transforms (each outputting 2×1×512) to generate style vectors y₁, y₂, y₃ that apply per-channel scale and offset adjustments at successive resolution levels of the generator. The main generative pipeline begins with a learned constant input (4×4×512) and passes through convolutional blocks that double in spatial resolution from 4×4×512 to 8×8×512, with each block receiving the corresponding style injection. The noise branch contributes three additive perturbations (z₁⊗ψ₁, z₂⊗ψ₂, z₃⊗ψ₃) from thin 4×4×1 or 8×8×1 noise volumes, each scaled and broadcast across all channels to introduce stochastic spatial variation at different resolutions. Underbrace labels at the bottom group the three columns under the headings Main generative pipeline, Noise, and Style. This figure demonstrates how StyleGAN separates high-level content from fine-grained stochastic detail by injecting global style information through adaptive normalization and local noise directly into the feature maps at each scale.

elements: learned constant input block 4×4×512 (grey box, far left of main pipeline)
first synthesis block 4×4×512 (orange box)
second synthesis block 8×8×512 (larger orange box)
third synthesis block 8×8×512 (larger orange box, with output image patch on its right face)
thin paired style-injection slabs (teal + dark blue) between consecutive main blocks — three pairs total
noise plane 4×4×1 above first style slab, labeled Noise z1 ⊗ ψ1 (teal vertical parallelogram)
noise plane 4×4×1 above second style slab, labeled Noise z2 ⊗ ψ2
noise plane 8×8×1 above third style slab, labeled Noise z3 ⊗ ψ3 (taller than the 4×4 planes)
downward arrows from each noise plane into the corresponding style slab, with caption 'Noise added to every channel'
latent variable z bar 1×1×512 (grey-blue horizontal bar, bottom left)
intermediate variable w bar 1×1×512 (orange horizontal bar, right of z)
'Fully connected network' label with arrow from z to w
horizontal distribution line running rightward from w beneath the three linear transforms
style y1 bar (orange) above first 'Linear transform 2×1×512' label
style y2 bar above second linear transform label
style y3 bar above third linear transform label
upward arrows from each style bar to its style slab, with caption 'Per-channel scale and offset' under the first
underbrace grouping labels on the left: 'Noise', 'Main generative pipeline', 'Style'

interactions.label: Trace pipeline
interactions.teaches: How information flows through StyleGAN: latent z is mapped by the fully connected network to w, w is broadcast through three linear transforms into styles y1–y3, and each style applies per-channel scale and offset at its synthesis block while noise is added to every channel — separating global style control from stochastic detail

interactions.label: Noise scale ψ
interactions.teaches: The per-resolution noise weight ψ scales the broadcast noise zᵢ⊗ψᵢ before it is added to every channel; at ψ=0 the image is fully determined by style, while larger ψ injects stronger stochastic variation at each resolution level
The 3D layout of the three branches (noise above, main pipeline in the middle, style below) and how the noise planes and style bars feed into the synthesis blocks

demo_steps.title: Overview
demo_steps.narration: The full architecture: constant input on the left, three synthesis blocks growing 4×4→8×8, noise planes injecting from above, and the style branch feeding per-channel scale/offset from below.

demo_steps.title: Trace the pipeline
demo_steps.narration: Step the trace: z lights up, flows through the fully connected network into w, w splits along the distribution line into the three linear transforms producing y1, y2, y3, and each style slab and synthesis block pulses in turn as scale/offset and noise are applied.

demo_steps.title: Kill the noise
demo_steps.narration: Set ψ = 0: the noise planes fade and the downward arrows shrink to nothing — the output becomes fully deterministic given w.

demo_steps.title: Full-strength noise
demo_steps.narration: Set ψ = 1: the noise planes brighten and the injected noise slabs pulse strongly at all three resolutions, showing stochastic detail being added to every channel at each scale.

interactionPlan.geometry_notes: Oblique layout read off the source: all boxes drawn with a true front face and depth receding up-right. Main pipeline runs left→right at mid height (y≈0): grey constant block ~2.2 wide × 0.9 tall × 0.7 deep at x≈-4.5; orange 4×4×512 block same size at x≈-1.8; two larger orange 8×8×512 blocks ~2.2×1.4×1.1 at x≈1.6 and x≈4.6. Between/after each pair of main blocks sits a thin teal slab (~0.25 wide, 1.0 tall) immediately followed by a dark blue slab — three teal+blue pairs at x≈-3.1, x≈-0.2, x≈3.1. Output pixelated image patch (thin slab with low-res skin-tone texture) attached to the right face of the last block. Noise planes float above at y≈+2.2: two small teal parallelograms (~0.35×0.9) above the first two slab pairs, one taller (~0.7×1.5) above the third; thin grey arrows drop from each into its slab. Style branch along the bottom at y≈-3: grey-blue z bar and orange w bar (~1.4×0.25×0.25) at x≈-5.2 and -3.4; horizontal distribution line from w rightward to x≈+4.6; three orange style bars y1,y2,y3 (~1.1×0.25×0.25) at y≈-2.0 under x≈-1.0, +1.6, +4.6, each with a thin arrow up to its slab pair. Underbrace labels stacked on far left: 'Noise' (top), 'Main generative pipeline' (middle), 'Style' (bottom). Colors: grey constant/z #b9c0c6, orange blocks/w/styles #d98a63, teal noise/slabs #a8d8cd, dark blue slabs #4a6a86, arrows thin grey-blue #8fa5b5, background off-white.
interactionPlan.notes: Build every box with BoxGeometry front face + extruded depth for the oblique look, flat MeshLambertMaterial. Pipeline trace: animate a glowing dot along z→w→distribution line→each linear transform→style bar→up arrow→slab pulse (teal/blue pair flashes) →synthesis block highlights; noise arrows animate downward simultaneously with each block pulse. Noise slider: scale noise-plane opacity (0.15→1.0), arrow length/thickness, and a pulsating emissive on the teal slabs. Keep underbrace labels as sprites/text on the left margin; all text labels as billboarded sprites. Orbit limited to gentle azimuth/elevation so the oblique readability is preserved.

discrepancies: Missing the short vertical arrows branching up from the w distribution line to each of the three style bars (source shows a branch arrow at each style)
Noise planes are flat camera-facing rectangles; the source draws them as tilted oblique plates, with the 8×8×1 plane notably larger and clearly angled
Teal/blue style slabs are plain rectangular boxes; the source draws them as rounded-top plate/blob shapes
'Fully connected network' annotation lacks the small pointer arrow to the z→w junction seen in the source and crowds the w-bar label
Output pixelated image patch is thinner/less prominent than the source's full-height output image on the last block
evaluation.notes: A faithful, well-labeled reconstruction of the StyleGAN diagram with strong interactions (trace animation, ψ slider, demo steps, clickable parts); minor geometric simplifications (flat noise planes, box slabs) and a few missing branch arrows keep it from a perfect match.
action_items: Add the three short vertical branch arrows from the w distribution line up to each style bar to match the source's branching structure
Tilt the noise planes (rotate around the vertical axis) so they read as oblique plates like the source, and enlarge the 8×8×1 plane further
Give the teal/blue style slabs rounded tops (e.g., extruded rounded-rectangle shapes) instead of plain boxes
Nudge the 'Fully connected network' label and add a small pointer arrow to the z→w junction to reduce crowding near the w bar label
